en.hubeali: H 14612 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man he mentioned, from Suleyman Bin Khalid who said:

‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘What did you do to myasws uncle Zayd?’ I said, ‘They were guarding him, so when the people dispersed, we took his body and buried him in on a cliff on the shores of Al-Furaat. When it was the morning, the horsemen came looking for him, so they found him and burnt his body’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So why did you not tie iron to him and throw him in Al-Furaat?
Greetings of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be upon him, and Curse of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be upon his killers’.
en.sarwar: 164. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from a man he mentioned, from Suleyman Bin Khalid who said:

‘Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said to me: ‘What did you do to my (a.s.) uncle Zayd?’ I said, ‘They were guarding him, so when the people dispersed, we took his body and buried him in on a cliff on the shores of Al-Furaat. When it was the morning, the horsemen came looking for him, so they found him and burnt his body’.
He (a.s.) said: ‘So why did you not tie iron to him and throw him in Al-Furaat?
Greetings of Allah (azwj) be upon him, and Curse of Allah (azwj) be upon his killers’.
